bear_assumptions: Normalized FCF per ADR falls to USD 3.40 and receives a 20x equity cash-flow multiple as commodity prices weaken, project investment remains elevated, and net debt declines slowly.
base_assumptions: Normalized FCF per ADR is USD 4.25 at 22x as Oyu Tolgoi ramps and productivity offsets inflation while favourable H1 copper, gold and aluminium prices partly normalize.
bull_assumptions: Normalized FCF per ADR reaches USD 5.50 at 23x as copper and aluminium pricing stays strong, Simandou ramps to plan, productivity improves conversion, and net debt falls.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a refreshed scenario set clears the expected-return, base-upside, bear-payoff and margin-of-safety gates at a fresh price, supported by continued Oyu Tolgoi ramp, maintained cost guidance and debt reduction; downgrade if commodity prices normalize faster, iron-ore demand weakens, project spending overruns, leverage rises, or per-share cash conversion deteriorates.
